headline: Pinterest teases a new ‘Restyle’ feature that lets you redesign your room with AI
context: Pinterest is testing Restyle, a new AI-powered feature that lets users visualize furniture, decor, lighting, and more in photos of their own rooms — potentially helping turn saved inspiration into purchases.
